metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 active electrodes using a QuickCap and Neuroscan SynampsRT amplifier at 1000 Hz sampling rate with impedance maintained below 10 kΩ. tDCS was delivered via Starstim 8 system with anodal electrode at either F3 (left dlPFC) or F4 (right dlPFC) in a between-subjects design, with return electrodes at FP1/FP2, FZ, FC1/FC2, FC5/FC6 respectively (8 cm² anodal, π cm² return electrode areas). Active stimulation consisted of 2 mA for 20 minutes with 30-second ramp-up; sham sessions included only ramp-up periods. EEG preprocessing included 0.1–30 Hz band-pass filtering, downsampling to 250 Hz, re-referencing to average mastoids, ICA decomposition with automatic IC rejection (ADJUST and SASICA), and artifact rejection using absolute amplitude and FASTER epoch properties criteria.
